Four Steps to Customization

From inquiry to delivery, we provide one-stop efficient service.

1

Consultation

Tell us your needs: bag type, size, quantity, and print content. Our professional consultants will recommend the best solution for you.

2

Design Confirmation

Send us your logo or design artwork. We provide free layout design services and start production only after you approve the mockup.

3

Sampling & Production

We support sample confirmation before mass production. Advanced equipment ensures quality, with strict inspection at every stage.

4

Delivery & Support

On-time delivery with multiple shipping options. Comprehensive after-sales service to ensure your satisfaction every time.

Why Choose Us As Your Bag Factory?

Factory direct — no middlemen. Quality and price guaranteed.

Factory Direct

As a direct tote bag manufacturer and canvas bag factory, we control every step from raw eco-friendly cotton sourcing to finished product — no middlemen, most competitive wholesale pricing.

Multiple Techniques

Silk-screen printing, heat transfer, DTG, embroidery, foil stamping — multiple techniques for custom printed logos to meet any bulk order design needs and budgets.

Low MOQ

100 pcs minimum for bulk orders, perfect for startups & events. No large-volume barrier — ideal for small batch testing and custom promotional campaigns.

Fast Delivery

Standard 7-10 days, rush 3-5 days. Our efficient production line ensures your event deadlines are always met.

Quality Assured

Strict quality management system, from fabric inspection to finished product sampling. Defect rate below 0.5%.

Dedicated Service

One-on-one account manager from inquiry to after-sales. Timely response to every need, making collaboration effortless.

Sustainability & Eco-Friendly Manufacturing

We believe custom bags should not cost the Earth. Every product we make is designed with sustainability in mind.

Sustainable Materials

100% organic cotton canvas, recycled PP non-woven fabric, and biodegradable wool-blend felt — all sourced from certified eco-friendly suppliers.

Reusable 50+ Times

Our bags replace single-use plastic bags for shopping, events, and daily life — reducing landfill waste with every use cycle.

Low Carbon Production

Energy-efficient manufacturing with solar power integration. Water-based inks for printing. Carbon-neutral shipping options available.

Recyclable & Biodegradable

At end of life, canvas bags can be composted or recycled as textile. Non-woven bags decompose faster than plastic alternatives.
